name: Cooler Master MasterMouse (MM530, MM711, MM720, MM730)
description: Per-LED lighting (scroll wheel, logo, MM530 buttons) of the Cooler Master MM530, MM711, MM720 and MM730 mice. Adapted from OpenRGB's CMMMController and CMMM711Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command (50 55), DPI and polling rate are never touched. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/coolermaster-mastermouse.md.
